messages:
Maya (Product): ACME asked for a compact multimodal summary beta next week. Need quick owner map + blockers.
Noah (Eng): Tight but possible. Main unknown: API for images + degrade path.
Priya (Runtime): Need KV-cache tweak for mixed tokens and a small tokenization shim for image embeddings. Need staging GPUs to benchmark.
Jamal (Infra): I can reserve 2x A10g for 72h. Tell me peak GPU mem and ephemeral disk needs.
Priya (Runtime): Peak ~18GB GPU mem. Disk only for decode, purge immediately. Batch: 6 users, ~400 tokens + one image (~1.2MB).
Elena (Security): Images can have PII. Must strip EXIF, use signed short-lived upload URLs, no persistent storage. I need 48h for threat review; if delayed we'll enforce mitigations.
Tomas (CS): ACME has DPA and ok with staged beta (500 users). They want rollback criteria and acceptance rubric.
Noah (Eng): Rollout: feature flag -> canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Need gateway kill-switch and runtime fast-fail for oversized images (>2MB).
Priya (Runtime): I'll add fast-fail + cache-bypass flag. ETA 36h for implementation and tests.
Maya (Product): Acceptance targets: p95 text <700ms; p95 multimodal <1.2s; opt-out for image processing.
Jamal (Infra): I'll run terraform tonight to create internal staging pool and mTLS endpoint.
Elena (Security): If review delayed: upload TTL=30s, limited SSO access, no analytics export. I'll post checklist by EOD.
Maya (Product): Action items:
- Elena: threat checklist by EOD (security)
- Jamal: staging GPUs + endpoint tonight (infra)
- Priya: shim + cache tweak + fast-fail in 36h (runtime)
- Noah: API contract + e2e fixtures in 48h (eng)
- Tomas: confirm ACME window + acceptance cases today (CS)
Noah (Eng): I'll draft the API spec here and push a small PR. If blockers pop up, 15m ad-hoc standup. :rocket:
